RFC 2918 Section 4 read: "Otherwise, the BGP speaker shall re- advertise to that peer the Adj-RIB-Out of the <AFI, SAFI> carried in the message, based on its outbound route filtering policy." The moved unit TestRFC2918RefreshRunsCurrentExportPolicy changed only the filter plumbing: The test filter is now an answerTransport behind filterTransportSeam, compiled by answerPolicy into a policychain library chain, so the verdict travels the real filter-update path (route.Input, rpc.FilterUpdateOutput decoded by the library chain) instead of the deleted policyFilterSeam that handed a PolicyResponse straight to the text chain; that is the production path every plugin filter now takes. It still answers accept, then reject once only the answer flips, and still requires one policy call with grown wire output on the accepting replay and identical wire bytes with a second call on the rejecting one, through exportFilterForBody on the session egress filter. The outbound policy decides the re-advertisement in both polarities; assertions unchanged. Other carriers byte-identical.
